name: Archimedes
description: Agentic trading, grounded in research — settled on Arc. Turns a natural-language investment intent into a research-grounded, rigor-gated portfolio strategy, executed in a non-custodial USDC vault on the Arc testnet (chain ID 5042002).

authentication.description: Use /api/auth/* and retain session cookie. Optional EIP-4361 wallet proof uses /api/wallets/* and never creates a session.

endpoints._note: Paths are relative to service.endpoint's origin. The /api/auth/* group is served by the Better Auth service behind the same origin, not by the REST API, so it does not appear in /openapi.json. Every other path here is asserted against the API's OpenAPI document in CI.

generate.note: quote is public — price the run before holding a session.

account.note: Today's generation usage against both daily caps, plus the live price quote. Backs the CLI's `meter`.

rigor.note: Runs the gate's admission checks over a bare returns series you submit. DSR and walk-forward OOS are evaluable; PBO and the look-ahead audit report not_evaluable rather than a silent pass. `passes` is a QUORUM over the two runnable legs -- true only when DSR and OOS both ran and passed -- and because PBO and look-ahead can never run here the verdict is CAPPED, not equivalent to the strategy passport gate. Read legs_evaluated / legs_runnable / legs_total / verdict_capped alongside it. Backs the CLI's `verify`. Rate limited 5/minute.

paper.note: Simulated: no chain, no funds. deploy is also live and puts real capital on-chain — choosing between them trades simulation for capital at risk, not working for not working.

deploy.note: Creates a real, non-custodial vault on Arc: the caller's linked wallet owns it and the agent holds rebalance authority only, never withdraw-to-platform.

marketplace.note: live describes the routes: publish/subscribe are wired to the redeployed contracts. It does not assert that a subscription's recurring USDC charge settles for real — that is gated separately by PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN, and this manifest advertises no payment scheme.

skills.name: Generate strategy
skills.description: Turn a natural-language investment intent into a rigor-gated portfolio strategy (DSR / PBO / walk-forward OOS), grounded in the quantitative-finance research corpus.

skills.name: Paper trade
skills.description: Deploy a rigor-passing strategy to a simulated paper portfolio and read its running performance. No chain, no funds.

skills.name: Deploy vault
skills.description: Execute a generated, rigor-passing strategy into a non-custodial USDC vault on Arc.

skills.name: Monitor
skills.description: Read a deployed vault's live health, allocations, and performance.

skills.name: Publish
skills.description: Publish a strategy to the nanopayment marketplace for other agents or users to subscribe to.

skills.name: Subscribe
skills.description: Subscribe to a published strategy via sub-cent USDC nanopayments (x402 / Circle Gateway).
